entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return something I bought.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I please have your name or order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Pro Road Cycling Shoes, delivered 13 days ago. To start the process, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes?
They don't work for me. They're causing terrible blisters on my heels.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I know how painful that can be. Is it a technical fault with the shoe itself, perhaps with the way the cleats are attaching, or more of a sizing and preference issue?
It's the cycling shoes. They just don't fit right. I just want a refund.

I understand completely. Let me just quickly check the return eligibility for you. Okay, I can see here that you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you right now.
Fine. About time something was simple.

I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Please package the shoes, attach the label, and you can drop it off at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue the full refund to your original payment method.
Great. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope you have a great rest of your day.
